info.title: Claude API
info.description:
Anthropic Claude API for creating and managing messages, batches, users, and invites.
Includes authentication, rate limits, and workspace-based organization.

Note: third-party community spec (github.com/97saurabh/ClaudeApiOpenApiSpec); Anthropic does not publish an official OpenAPI document.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Maximum number of time buckets to return in the response.
The default and max limits depend on `bucket_width`:
• "1d": Default 7 days, max 31 days
• "1h": Default 24 hours, max 168 hours
• "1m": Default 60 minutes, max 1440 minutes

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optionally set to the `next_page` token from the previous response.

parameters.name: starting_at
parameters.description:
Time buckets that start on or after this RFC 3339 timestamp will be returned.
Each bucket is snapped to the start of the minute/hour/day in UTC.

parameters.name: ending_at
parameters.description: Time buckets that end before this RFC 3339 timestamp will be returned.

starting_at.title: Starting At
starting_at.description: Start of the time bucket (inclusive) in RFC 3339 format.

ending_at.title: Ending At
ending_at.description: End of the time bucket (exclusive) in RFC 3339 format.

results.title: Results
results.description: List of cost items for this time bucket. There may be multiple items if one or more `group_by[]` parameters are specified.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency code for the cost amount. Currently always "USD".

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Cost amount in lowest currency units (e.g. cents) as a decimal string. For example, "123.45" in "USD" represents "$1.23".

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: ID of the Workspace this cost is associated with. Null if not grouping by workspace or for the default workspace.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the cost item. Null if not grouping by description.

cost_type.title: Cost Type
cost_type.description: Type of cost. Null if not grouping by description.

context_window.title: Context Window
context_window.description: Input context window used. Null if not grouping by description or for non-token costs.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name used. Null if not grouping by description or for non-token costs.

service_tier.title: Service Tier
service_tier.description: Service tier used. Null if not grouping by description or for non-token costs.

token_type.title: Token Type
token_type.description: Type of token. Null if not grouping by description or for non-token costs.

has_more.title: Has More
has_more.description: Indicates if there are more results.

next_page.title: Next Page
next_page.description: Token to provide as `page` in the subsequent request to retrieve the next page of data.
